Quality gate: caught vs not caught

Architecture A on d1_grouped (enhanced_res, no retraining). Synthetic corruptions of 553 test-half crops (up to 8 per photo family, 87 families). Pipeline: quality gate (α 0.1) → OOD gate (α 0.1) → prob-T + family-weighted LAC (α 0.1). Examples are random, one per family where possible.

Reading the numbers. sharp = variance of the Laplacian (low = blurry); bright = mean grey 0–255; white / black = share of pixels ≥ 250 / ≤ 5. Typical normal (val) crop: sharp 35, bright 142, white 0.0%, black 0.0%. A crop is stopped for quality when its quality p-value ≤ 0.1: its most extreme statistic is rarer than in all but ~10% of normal calibration families. "Holds truth" / "WRONG" says whether the visor message contains the true class.

Synthetic only: no real helmet footage, and no partial shadows (the dark test darkens the whole crop).
